$comment: HAND-AUTHORED overlay model rows — the reviewed half of the catalog, which upstream extraction and live discovery may never overwrite (WS-13 §7). One resolvable row per cohort provider (two or three where a lane needs a plain, a reasoning and a flagship model), so every adapter lane has something to resolve against its loopback fake. EVERY row is `status: "candidate"`: promotion to `supported` requires the behavioural corpus (WS-13 §13), which no row has run. NO row carries `classifierEligible` — R6-14 sets that only after the safety corpus passes live, so the answer here is Manual fallback, the fail-safe direction. `pricing` is present ONLY where a vendor's own pricing page states a list price for that exact model, with the page URL as `sourceRef` and the observation instant: R6-H makes this the only price source and `costBasis: "list"` a claim about published prices, so an unpriced row carries no `pricing` key at all rather than an invented number. Gateway, Azure-deployment, Bedrock and Vertex rows are deliberately unpriced — their prices are the reseller's, not the vendor list, and no page was read for them.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: continuity report §6.1, BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: a `thoughtSignature` is returned to the SAME model on its exact original part — "do not concatenate signed parts; do not move a signature to a different part; preserve every accumulated signature in a sequential function-call turn".
